Passive payment may have payer null. Wages establish a payment but not annual income, cash medium, or a payment date. Coordinated recipients that cannot be assigned to one source payment key make this relation unread.
Read facts only. Preserve current source keys. Do not infer missing dates, people or places. Complete scans enumerate every relevant source record. Ambiguity is unread. Return the named relation wrapper.
